name: week-at-a-glance
description: The household's Sunday–Saturday week at a glance: both calendars and the weather, on a TRMNL X by the front door and on a web page.

scripts.dev: npm run shared && firebase emulators:start --project demo-week-at-a-glance
scripts.test: npm run shared && node --test tests/week.test.js && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-week-at-a-glance --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/functions.test.js tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-week-at-a-glance --only auth,firestore,hosting "node tests/e2e.mjs"
